errors.evidence: The description claims that the categories on the y-axis are sorted in descending order based on the number of responses. This is incorrect. The first category, "Общ пълнител", has 6 responses, while the second category, "Обратен насип", has 11 responses.

The category label in the chart is truncated to "Фирмите изпълнител са задъ...". The description completes this phrase as "Фирмите изпълнител са задължени", which is an assumption not explicitly stated in the figure.

The category label in the chart is truncated to "Влагането им е икономически...". The description completes this phrase as "Влагането им е економически изгодно", which is an assumption not explicitly stated in the figure.
This is a spelling error. The correct spelling in Bulgarian is "икономически".
